label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Championship lead
items.text: Beau Hossler leads the Wyndham Championship at 12-under through 1 hole on Saturday, one shot ahead of Nico Echavarria, Ben James, and Jordan Smith at 11-under.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau's return
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau expressed his desire to play PGA Tour events again, keeping his return hopes alive.

items.headline: Jim McLean health update
items.text: Legendary golf coach Jim McLean, who spent nearly four decades coaching, shared an emotional health update after being pronounced dead twice.
